personalInfo.name: Shubham Memane
personalInfo.title: Full Stack Developer
personalInfo.bio: Passionate developer with expertise in Flutter, Web, and Mobile development. I create beautiful, performant applications with clean code and modern architecture.

projects.title: Riise
projects.description: Know your portfolio with True Wealth. Invest via Demat Account with real-time market insights.
projects.longDescription: Riise by Motilal Oswal lets you track and grow your wealth with a True Wealth view of your entire portfolio. Invest in stocks, mutual funds, and IPOs through a seamlessly integrated Demat account. Features real-time market data, portfolio analytics, secure biometric login, and actionable investment insights to help you make smarter financial decisions.

projects.title: MO Private Wealth
projects.description: Exclusive wealth management platform for high-net-worth investors with personalised advisory and portfolio tracking.
projects.longDescription: MO Private Wealth is Motilal Oswal's premium wealth management app designed for high-net-worth individuals. Offers personalized investment advisory, portfolio performance tracking, estate planning tools, and direct access to relationship managers. Built with Flutter for a seamless cross-platform experience with enterprise-grade security.

projects.title: MO Trader
projects.description: Professional trading platform with real-time market data and portfolio management.
projects.longDescription: MO Trader is a professional trading platform for Motilal Oswal, built with Flutter. It provides real-time market data, stock charting, portfolio management, and one-tap trading execution. Handles high-frequency data updates with optimized rendering, features a dark-themed trading UI, and integrates secure authentication with biometric support.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: Beautiful weather application with location-based forecasts, interactive maps, and weather alerts.
projects.longDescription: A beautiful weather application built with Flutter using the OpenWeather API for accurate location-based forecasts, 7-day predictions, hourly breakdowns, and severe weather alerts. Google Maps integration shows interactive radar overlays. Features animated weather icons, widget support, and an Apple Watch companion app.

projects.title: Torus: Banking, Trading, Demat
projects.description: All-in-one financial platform with banking, trading, and demat account management.
projects.longDescription: Torus is a comprehensive fintech application combining banking, stock trading, and demat account management in a single Flutter app. Features include UPI payments, mutual fund investments, IPO applications, equity trading with real-time quotes, account statements, and secure KYC onboarding. Available on both iOS and Android.

experiences.description: Leading mobile development initiatives, architecting scalable financial applications, and implementing best practices for secure trading platforms.
Developed cross-platform mobile applications, integrated third-party APIs, and optimized app performance for better user experience.
Built and maintained multiple Flutter applications, collaborated with cross-functional teams, and implemented modern UI/UX designs.
Developed native and hybrid mobile applications, integrated REST APIs, and worked on client projects with agile methodology.
Started professional journey developing enterprise applications, learned industry best practices, and contributed to large-scale projects.
